_note: Sweep batch 03: tier-1 passages 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-09. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch Ukraine because Russia and Ukraine are going to be buddies, and that when that is seen it is the sign of a world war escalation; he also saw a draft coming and Turkey turning its back and attempting ground invasions.
mentions.quote: this is the sign for an escalation of World War
mentions.falsify_match: A Russia-Ukraine rapprochement followed by wider war escalation and a US draft.
mentions.falsify_miss: No rapprochement, or one that does not precede escalation.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told California will have an earthquake not seen in these generations, a massive one about to happen, and connects it to water and food.
mentions.quote: California will have a earthquake that has not been seen in this
mentions.falsify_match: A California earthquake larger than any in the last several generations.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such earthquake occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He prays to win the House and Senate, and recalls hearing the Muslim Brotherhood called into action in battleground states, telling listeners to watch Michigan, Detroit, Minnesota and the north over the Senate races.
mentions.quote: Watch Michigan and watch for Detroit. Watch Detroit. Watch Minnesota
mentions.falsify_match: Michigan and Minnesota prove decisive Senate battlegrounds in November 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither state is competitive.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is cleaning up his church for the rest of 2026 and into 2027, citing 1 Corinthians 5:5, and that this is what is happening in America.
mentions.quote: I'M CLEANING UP MY church for the rest of 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A run of public scandals and closures across American churches through 2026 and 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No unusual level of church upheaval.

mentions.claim_text: Worship singing of 'As the deer panteth' during the prayer stream.
mentions.quote: You alone are my heart's desire and I long to worship you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sung worship, no claim.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: Pointing to a Michigan or Minnesota clip he says he told listeners the cells would be activated, that they were in Detroit, and that the Lord showed a shaking in Michigan and Minnesota with a push to get out and vote.
mentions.quote: I said activate the sales. They were in Detroit
mentions.falsify_match: Organised Islamist political mobilisation reported in Michigan and Minnesota.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such organised activity is documented.

mentions.claim_text: He says Starlink will be government funded and that people will have a ring on their finger, calling it the beginning of a new technology that is part of the beast system, and says he is excited because it means Jesus is coming.
mentions.quote: you'll have a ring on your finger
mentions.falsify_match: A government-backed wearable ring rolled out with identity or payment functions.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such device reaches mass adoption.

mentions.claim_text: Asked when the plague is coming, he says he keeps seeing the end of 2027 going into 2028, specifically January to June, describing it as very bad, a blackness on the earth, with darkness coming out of labs.
mentions.quote: the end of 2027 is what I've seen multiple times
mentions.time_phrase: end of 2027 into 2028, January to June
mentions.falsify_match: A major pandemic of laboratory origin beginning between late 2027 and mid 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such outbreak in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know about a wealth transfer in September, is praying for the Clarity Act to pass, and that the Lord said the wealth transfer must be contended for rather than simply received.
mentions.quote: you have to contend for the wealth transfer
mentions.condition_text: the transfer requires contending in prayer
mentions.falsify_match: A visible wealth transfer to his audience in September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: September passes with none, which the contending clause pre-excuses.

mentions.claim_text: In August he returns to the tulip he saw, says he watched it come up out of the ground again, and describes beautiful coloured lights alongside it.
mentions.quote: I saw it come up out of the ground again and I saw the lights
mentions.falsify_match: A speculative bubble of the kind the tulip image implies.
mentions.falsify_miss: No identifiable referent for the image.

mentions.claim_text: He says everybody could see it once it was too late, ties it to certain investments, and reports being told to remember the time frames of what he is shown, before replaying a clip from 11 August of last year.
mentions.quote: Remember the time frames of things that I show you
mentions.falsify_match: An investment move that is obvious only in hindsight, matching his dated clip.
mentions.falsify_miss: The replayed clip does not match what followed.

mentions.claim_text: Personal story about a relative who retired, saved hard and died suddenly before a planned cruise.
mentions.quote: you save all that money and you put it back
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal anecdote.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He urges listeners to stay on God's side and depend on him, then introduces a replay of his 12 August 2025 word.
mentions.quote: It's always to be on God's side of everything
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation plus a clip introduction.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: In the replayed clip he reaches January and sees a parchment scroll like the Declaration of Independence, with Trump using a golden feather quill to write new legislation concerning America and something digital.
mentions.quote: he started writing new legislation on this concerning the United States
mentions.falsify_match: Major digital-money legislation signed by Trump around January.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such signing.

mentions.claim_text: He notes these were the things prayed about in 2025 and says they are going round the mountain again in 2026, then asks whether Trump will sign with the golden pen soon, whether it will be January, and whether it will make the economy look better.
mentions.quote: Will Trump sign with the golden pin soon? Will it be in January?
mentions.falsify_match: The golden-pen signing happens by January 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that Warsaw warns Russia may use captured Ukrainian drones against Poland, and says this is the first stage of what he predicted, having named Warsaw and Poland.
mentions.quote: I said it will be by Warsaw and Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Russian drone attacks on Polish territory.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attacks on Poland occur.

mentions.claim_text: He discusses news that state-backed loan guarantees were approved to keep companies afloat for now, and alleges embezzled money laundered to Swiss and foreign accounts.
mentions.quote: loans guaranteed were approved by by KF to keep companies for now
mentions.falsify_match: The loan guarantee programme proves a bridge to a larger failure.
mentions.falsify_miss: The companies recover.

mentions.claim_text: Banter about next month's phone launch at fourteen hundred dollars with a bigger battery and telescopic lens.
mentions.quote: they say it's going to be $1,400
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: consumer product banter with no claim of his own.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a free and fair election with no voter fraud, all fraudulent mail-in ballots and computer hacks uncovered, and the right men and women placed in office.
mentions.quote: All voter fraud be revealed
mentions.falsify_match: Documented fraud is uncovered and prosecuted around the 2026 election.
mentions.falsify_miss: No substantiated fraud is found.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees concern in September, a flag on top of a building with smoke around it, rubble and a ground zero resembling 9/11, and states plainly that he does not know what year it is.
mentions.quote: You say, "What year is this?" I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A mass-casualty attack leaving a US ground zero in some September.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event, though with no year given this cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He urges listeners to speak the gospel even when it is socially awkward at Thanksgiving or Christmas, because theirs may be the only gospel someone ever hears.
mentions.quote: maybe the gospel from your mouth is the only gospel they will ever hear
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation to evangelise.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that once the midterms are over they do not try to use the 25th amendment to remove Trump, says the country needs Trump rather than JD Vance, and reports seeing a world war trying to come on the scene.
mentions.quote: they don't try to put 20 the 25th amendment to impeach you
mentions.condition_text: he prays the removal attempt down
mentions.falsify_match: A 25th amendment or impeachment push against Trump after the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No removal attempt is mounted.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls saying California would have the big one, and points to news of 3 August in which a top California earthquake expert issues a warning that it could come at any time.
mentions.quote: You're going to see California have the big one
mentions.falsify_match: A great California earthquake follows the warning.
mentions.falsify_miss: The warning passes without an event.

mentions.claim_text: He says the California earthquake will be a sign that a major revival is coming to California in the days ahead, and dates the underlying word to 1 August.
mentions.quote: this will be a sign that a major revival is coming to California
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival movement in California following a major quake.
mentions.falsify_miss: No revival, or no quake to serve as the sign.

mentions.claim_text: Personal testimony that he barely holds a GED, failed it twice, and asked God to use whatever he had.
mentions.quote: I took it three times and failed twice
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: biographical testimony.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he sees the end of January, December and 2027, says the word mango, and repeatedly sees a lot of blue and a blue stealth.
mentions.quote: I see the blue stealth. I see the blue
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable December-January event matching the blue and stealth imagery.
mentions.falsify_miss: No referent is ever supplied for the images.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats seeing baby blue, and places it in January.
mentions.quote: In January, I see baby blue
mentions.falsify_match: A January event matching the baby blue image.
mentions.falsify_miss: No referent is supplied.

mentions.claim_text: He extends the same sequence into the second week and says he sees it in February.
mentions.quote: even into the second week. I see it in February
mentions.falsify_match: The same unnamed thing recurs into February.
mentions.falsify_miss: No referent is supplied.

mentions.claim_text: He sees fields of wheat ready to reap in the fall, notes this is out of the normal harvest season, and says a harvest is coming in September and October so people should get ready.
mentions.quote: I hear that in October, September, Octo wheat is ready to reap
mentions.falsify_match: An out-of-season wheat harvest, or a spiritual harvest, in autumn 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Autumn 2026 passes with neither.

mentions.claim_text: He says the ring will detect cancer and pre-stroke conditions and all kinds of medical states, that this is the first phase, and that they will push it hard over the next five years by 2030 and 2031 while medical science doubles.
mentions.quote: they will really push over the next five years
mentions.falsify_match: Wearable rings marketed with cancer and stroke detection by 2031.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such capability ships.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the busting up of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac investment groups, and says that once things are cashless there will be no tax fraud and no way for people to finagle their finances.
mentions.quote: there will be no tax fraud
mentions.falsify_match: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are restructured or broken up under a cashless regime.
mentions.falsify_miss: They continue unchanged.

mentions.claim_text: He says revival is coming to the nation, the bride is being brought to his side, a remnant rises with great glory, and a major harvest of souls comes in select places rather than everywhere.
mentions.quote: it won't be everywhere, but it will be in these select places
mentions.falsify_match: A geographically concentrated American revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: No revival movement of note.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is doing something in Israel and he sees a major revival coming for the Jewish people, with people and Orthodox Jews weeping at the Wailing Wall, and a shaking coming to the people of Israel around October.
mentions.quote: I see a major revival coming for the Jewish people
mentions.falsify_match: A reported Jewish revival movement in Israel with scenes at the Western Wall.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He saw a man in a yarmulke described as a new person coming, is unsure whether it happens this year, notes he did not know Israel had an October election, and says that as of September a shaking is coming.
mentions.quote: as of the month of September, there's a shaking coming
mentions.falsify_match: A new Israeli leader takes office around the October vote.
mentions.falsify_miss: The incumbent holds.

mentions.claim_text: He says the point of no return was passed last year, that acceleration now begins and the birthing pains increase from Rosh Hashanah on 11 September, which he places five or six weeks away.
mentions.quote: we've passed the point of no return last year
mentions.falsify_match: A marked step change in the pace of events from 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No inflection at that date.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that 194 earthquakes have struck Italy since 31 July, set off by a destructive magnitude 4.7, and recalls saying there would be a sign before the major one, asking whether this relieved the pressure.
mentions.quote: you'll have a sign before the major one
mentions.falsify_match: A major Italian earthquake or eruption follows the swarm.
mentions.falsify_miss: The swarm fades with no major event.

mentions.claim_text: Devotional prayer asking what has more of him than God does, and yielding to the Holy Spirit alone.
mentions.quote: There will only be you, Holy Spirit
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: devotional prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying that leaders who reject Israel reject him, and recounts a dream of a massive storm like a tidal wave coming along the northeast of America and running down the east coast to the south.
mentions.quote: I saw a massive storm coming along the northeast of America
mentions.falsify_match: A major storm surge running the US northeast down the eastern seaboard.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such storm.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord warning the White House not to touch his land, naming Gaza, the Golan Heights and the West Bank as his and belonging to the Jewish people rather than Palestine.
mentions.quote: don't touch my land. Gaza is mine
mentions.falsify_match: Adverse consequences follow an American-brokered partition of those territories.
mentions.falsify_miss: A partition proceeds without the consequences he implies.

mentions.claim_text: Discussing the two-state solution he says every road paves toward it, and cites a Kim Clement word dated 1 November 2014 alongside the family still keeping that ministry going.
mentions.quote: two-state solution. Um so I see these things and every road paves
mentions.falsify_match: A two-state agreement is reached.
mentions.falsify_miss: The process collapses.

mentions.claim_text: He says a new Watergate scandal will come out of the White House from pressure on X, that it will involve JD Vance, that they will call it the scandal of 2028, and that he saw a new Whitewater like Nixon's Watergate.
mentions.quote: there will be a new Watergate scandal come out of the White House
mentions.falsify_match: A Watergate-scale White House scandal implicating Vance, tied to pressure on X.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such scandal by the end of 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He says legacy networks are exalted again and a new alternative promoted to displace Elon's platform around the 2026 and 2028 elections, described as a quid pro quo where cooperation buys lighter treatment.
mentions.quote: trying to take out the alternative with Elon in this concerning the elections
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated push against X in favour of a rival platform across those cycles.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such push.

mentions.claim_text: Pointing to 94 earthquakes in one day at a named cove he says there would be signs before the major volcano erupts, and that when it does it will send a tsunami wave inland flooding the whole Naples coastline.
mentions.quote: it sends a tsunami wave inland and it floods all the coastline
mentions.falsify_match: A volcanic eruption near Naples producing a tsunami that floods the coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: No eruption or no tsunami.

mentions.claim_text: He describes poisonous gases rising from the land that people could not breathe, a canary in the coal mine, and says the Lord told him to watch Venice for major shakings, dating that word to 5 July 2023.
mentions.quote: There'll be a major shakings in Venice
mentions.falsify_match: Seismic or volcanic gas events at Venice.
mentions.falsify_miss: Venice is unaffected.

mentions.claim_text: Playing an Indo-Pacific clip he says it is already happening, that the Lord said watch China, Russia and Belarus concerning Poland and a world war, and that he saw Kim take on a major role in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: The Lord said watch Bell Barus uh concerning Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Belarus becomes a route of escalation toward Poland, with North Korea prominent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Belarus and North Korea stay peripheral.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a word from June last year that they would clone a dodo and woolly mammoths, and says he saw a part-elephant woolly mammoth born in a lab and taken into a zoo, with a sabre-tooth to follow.
mentions.quote: I saw an actual woolly mammoth be born in a lab
mentions.falsify_match: A mammoth-elephant hybrid is born in a lab and put on public display.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such animal is produced.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a Trump clip on drug prices in which Trump says the scenes he watched in Spain looked like an invasion by hundreds of thousands and that the same will happen to America, much worse, if Republicans are not elected.
mentions.quote: that same thing's going to happen to us if the Republicans don't get elected
mentions.condition_text: conditional on Republicans losing, in Trump's own framing
mentions.falsify_match: Mass disorder over migration in the US following Republican losses.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such disorder.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer over the month of August for closeness to God, provision, healing and lacking no good thing.
mentions.quote: We lift up the month of August to you, Lord
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: general prayer for provision.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that expiration dates are arriving for many people on what they have been believing for, whether healing or a marriage, and that the time is now.
mentions.quote: The expiration dates are happening for many people
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal answered-prayer claims with no shared criterion.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He says August will be a time of great turnaround that people will be able to put a timestamp on, and points to the end of the year for the fuller result.
mentions.quote: This will be a time in August of a great turnaround in our lives
mentions.time_phrase: August, then end of the year
mentions.falsify_match: A turn in circumstances datable to August 2026 and visible by year end.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such turn.
